notes:
BUILD 7
- Bow: held off to the right, comes to the middle as you pull back or aim
- Research: no item needed. The research table is a board of blueprints; click one and pay its scrap
- Building: the plan works at arm's length. Look at where a piece goes and a see-through ghost snaps to it, red with the reason if it can't; pieces land with dust and a knock
- Building: twig is a frame of sticks. New pieces: half wall, low wall, foundation steps
- Building: stability. The hammer shows how well a piece is held up; floors reach three cells from a wall, and what loses its support comes down. The hammer wheel can rotate stairs and roofs

BUILD 6
- Sound: every gun rebuilt as a real blast with a tail rolling off instead of a click with a bass note under it
- Eoka: flint on steel when it fails to catch; when it goes off, the strike, the boom and the pipe splitting
- Hits, footsteps, landing, doors, explosions, barrels, the lock's jolt and more redone and measured against real recordings
- Gunshots carry much further and get duller with distance
- Radio: the band stations play written songs now (24 of them) with verses, choruses and breaks, and the band is mixed so the tune comes through

BUILD 5
- Outpost fixed: the vending machines, the Air Wolf booth and the benches no longer vanish. Walk up, press E, pay in scrap
- Rock: swings over and down in a curve, and is picked up without the toss
- Hatchet: no flip when you take it out, and missed swings no longer twist the arms
- Bow: carried low on the left with the arrow showing, lines up with the crosshair when drawn or aimed
- Jackhammer: points at the crosshair, leans in and hammers while LMB is held
- Eokas from loot are always loaded and no longer vanish in the hand
- Shift-click hand-overs finish even if you close the box at once; loot crates don't take your items
- The exe has its own icon

BUILD 4
- The game now lives on GitHub and updates itself from the title screen
- Code lock on first launch

BUILD 3
- Animation pass: every tool and gun has its own draw, swings and reloads
- Look down and you see your own body; jackhammer
- Junk piles, wrecks and barrels along the roads; mining outpost rebuilt
- Helicopters remodelled; scrap exchange at the outpost
